findings.evidence: ARCH:300 "`e` shows `export disabled (destination undecided)` and each live snapshot write is skipped"; acceptance-tests.md:19 T27 "`e`/`--once` writes the record export".
findings.suggested_fix: Choose a default destination that satisfies T27 and CAP-10 while UX-OQ-4 stays open, or record the conflict as a CONTRADICTION against the spec and do not adopt the skip as the default.

findings.finding: ARCH CD-16 and AD-10 (ARCH:130) set the default that each ledger row names its `worktreeId`. UX's PROPOSED default names it only in the inspector and the export, and leaves the row open (UX-OQ-8). The spec ledger has no worktree column (rendering-rules.md:29).
findings.evidence: ARCH:310 "Each row names its shared `worktreeId`... because T20 requires it"; EXPERIENCE.md:243 "inspector and the plain-text export name the full `resource.worktreeId`... Whether the ledger row itself must name the worktree is open".
findings.suggested_fix: Align the two defaults: either UX adopts row naming with a column, or ARCH adopts the inspector-and-export default and cites rendering-rules.md:29.
